firms.name: PwC

patterns: Internal knowledge OS first (Lilli/Sage), then client productization
Intelligence/context layer owned separately from the LLM (BCG EnterpriseIQ)
Industry/domain worker catalog, not a universal agent (Zora, AI Refinery)
Orchestration + governance plane over many agents (PwC agent OS)
Graduated autonomy: shadow → supervised → guided → full (BCG 2026)
Forward-deployed engineers as the delivery system (Deloitte Zora)
Employee-built tools at scale need a platform, not permission (Bain custom GPTs)
